title_o: Modelling goal adjustment in social relationships: Two experimental studies with children and adults

replications.quote: Observers in the disengagement group (M = 4.71, SD = 1.40) switched significantly more often than participants in the control group (M = 3.82, SD = 1.34), mean difference = 0.88, BCa 95% CI [0.16, 1.58], d = 0.65.
